name: ai-job-search
description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
one_liner: A toolkit that reads job postings, rewrites your resume and cover letter to match each one, and preps you for the interview — running entirely on your own laptop.
buyer: An independent career coach who wants to offer 'AI-tailored application' packages to job-seeking clients without building any software themselves.
business_use_cases: A career coach runs it for clients during paid 1:1 sessions, turning a 2-hour resume-rewrite into a 20-minute guided workflow.
An outplacement firm bundles it into severance packages for laid-off employees as a 'done with you' job search accelerator.
A bootcamp or university career center offers it as a lab exercise so grads leave with 10 tailored applications instead of one generic resume.

money_ideas.idea: Sell 1:1 'set this up for you' sessions to non-technical job seekers who can't install Python/LaTeX/Claude Code themselves.
Offer a monthly 'application concierge' subscription where you run it weekly against new postings on a client's behalf.

steal_this: This weekend, set it up for three job-seeking friends, run their applications through it, and charge a flat fee per finished application packet — you're the install layer most non-coders can't do themselves.
